sourceFile: 38. TIU C11-20  Report Test VP V3.3 2026.1.22. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for Ask AI.
issues: Review title is a graph frequency row, not the report subject.
Primary changed factor is ambiguous and likely misstates Day shift as a changed condition.
Baseline/test grouping mixes Normal, VP V3.3 positions, shift, and sample position context.
Measurement outcomes include header/spec rows and nonsensical aggregates.
Several key result citations are not supported by visible row context.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended comparison Normal vs VP V3.3 POS #1-4 after EDGE V3.3 mold change?
correctionPlan: Define primary change from purpose/content rows as EDGE V3.3 mold or VP V3.3 position test, not graph labels.
Rebuild function outcome using Test result rows with Normal and each POS as separate conditions.
Separate SPL/THD/raw soundcheck tables from function NG-rate results under the same validation context only if comparable.
Remove header-derived measurement stats and cite actual data rows plus table headers.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations mix headers, graph rows, and data; row-level evidence is insufficient until regrouped.
